Thanks — putting a quick technical prep note here.

Load test plan (attached: load_test_plan.xlsx):
- Tests:
  • Steady-state: 15 concurrent, 120s duration, 95th token latency target < 250ms
  • Burst: 40 req/s for 30s (smoke) — "do not exceed" threshold unless infra approves
- Payload: two prompt sets (Support Triage, Sales Assist), token lengths ~100–150
- Routing: we'll exercise two routing policies during the session:
  1) low-latency route (redwood/rt-medium)
  2) cost-efficient fallback (redwood/quantized-small)
  We will show differences in per-token cost and latency.
- KV cache: we'll warm the cache with 20 short prefixes for the Support Triage set to observe cold vs warm behavior.

Operational items for ACME:
- Provide a sandbox URL + a service account or IP list (as infra suggested).
- Drop 4–6 anonymized sample prompts for each scenario in the Drive folder so we can pre-generate expected responses for the runbook.

I'll be on the session and will bring the test harness + a short dashboard to surface token breakdowns. If infra wants, we can do the stress run at 6:30pm PT the same day (separate run).

— Dev Patel
